name: Exp_Omni_Trend
summary: This EA is a multi-timeframe trend-following system that combines trend detection across several timeframes to generate trade signals. It uses multiple indicators to confirm trend direction and enters positions only when higher and lower timeframe trends align. The system includes position management with stop loss and take profit, along with filtering mechanisms to avoid unfavorable market conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个多周期趋势跟踪系统，通过结合多个时间周期的趋势检测来生成交易信号。它使用多个指标确认趋势方向，仅当高周期和低周期趋势一致时才入场。系统包含止损止盈的仓位管理，以及避免不利市场条件的过滤机制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用多周期趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是在多个时间周期上确认趋势一致性后才开仓。入场条件要求高时间周期（如H4或D1）趋势方向与低时间周期（如M15或H1）趋势方向一致，并且动量指标确认趋势强度。出场条件包括固定止损止盈，以及趋势反转信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA设置了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但多周期信号同步可能导致入场机会较少，在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a multi-timeframe trend following strategy, with the core concept requiring trend alignment confirmation across multiple timeframes before opening positions. Entry conditions demand that the higher timeframe (e.g., H4 or D1) trend direction matches the lower timeframe (e.g., M15 or H1) trend direction, with momentum indicators confirming trend strength. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as trend reversal signals triggering position closure. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and per-trade risk control. The overall strategy logic is clear, but multi-timeframe signal synchronization may result in fewer entry opportunities, and frequent false signals can occur in ranging markets.

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade (in money management mode)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

pros: 多周期趋势确认有效减少假信号，提高入场质量
包含止损止盈和最大持仓限制，风险控制较为完善
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强便于优化
支持动态仓位计算，适应不同资金规模
多指标交叉验证增强了信号可靠性
pros_en: Multi-timeframe trend confirmation effectively reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Includes stop loss, take profit, and maximum position limits for sound risk management
Clear and understandable strategy logic with adjustable parameters for optimization
Supports dynamic position sizing to adapt to different account sizes
Multiple indicator cross-validation enhances signal reliability
cons: 多周期同步要求可能导致入场机会较少，错过部分行情
震荡市中趋势跟踪策略容易产生连续亏损
缺乏自适应机制，市场状态切换时表现不稳定
参数较多，过度优化风险较高
缺少加仓和减仓的灵活仓位管理机制
cons_en: Multi-timeframe synchronization requirements may lead to fewer entry opportunities, missing some market moves
Trend following strategies tend to produce consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks adaptive mechanism, performance is unstable during market regime transitions
Many parameters create risk of overfitting during optimization
Lacks flexible position scaling mechanisms for adding or reducing positions
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块，在震荡市中自动暂停交易或切换策略
加入移动止损和保本止损功能，更好地保护盈利
引入自适应参数调整机制，根据市场波动率动态调整止损止盈
improvements_en: Add market regime detection module to automatically pause trading or switch strategies in ranging markets
Implement trailing stop and break-even stop features to better protect profits
Introduce adaptive parameter adjustment mechanism to dynamically adjust SL/TP based on market volatility

risk_points: 多周期趋势策略在震荡市中可能连续止损造成资金回撤
固定止损点数未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过宽
缺少价差过滤可能导致在高点差时段入场
risk_points_en: Multi-timeframe trend strategy may suffer consecutive stop losses causing drawdown in ranging markets
Fixed stop loss pips don't account for volatility changes, potentially too wide during low volatility
Lacks spread filter which may cause entries during high spread periods

summary_en: This EA is a multi-timeframe trend-following system that combines trend detection across several timeframes to generate trade signals. It uses multiple indicators to confirm trend direction and enters positions only when higher and lower timeframe trends align. The system includes position management with stop loss and take profit, along with filtering mechanisms to avoid unfavorable market conditions.
